name: Ultrawave Internet
summary: Dialup/ISDN/ADSL ISP launched 2003 by RMI Telecommunications (parent of Stealth Internet); Comindico-reseller; offices in Griffith (base), Melbourne and Sydney; acquired by DART Internet Sep 2003 and merged into DART.

events.details: ultrawave.com.au first captured by the Wayback Machine 22 Jun 2003; ABN 'ULTRAWAVE INTERNET' (cancelled). Launched by RMI Telecommunications (which had taken over Stealth Internet's operations in 1998).
Acquired by DART Internet (announced 13 Sep 2003); Ultrawave merged into DART, staff released, customers migrated.
